title: inference.put_groq
description:
Create a Groq inference endpoint.

Create an inference endpoint to perform an inference task with the `groq` service.

timeout.description: Specifies the amount of time to wait for the inference endpoint to be created.

service.description: The type of service supported for the specified task type. In this case, `groq`.

service_settings.description: Settings used to install the inference model. These settings are specific to the `groq` service.

task_type.description: The type of the inference task that the model will perform.

groq_inference_id.description: The unique identifier of the inference endpoint.

error_trace.description:
When set to `true` Elasticsearch will include the full stack trace of errors
when they occur.

filter_path.description:
Comma-separated list of filters in dot notation which reduce the response
returned by Elasticsearch.

human.description:
When set to `true` will return statistics in a format suitable for humans.
For example `"exists_time": "1h"` for humans and
`"exists_time_in_millis": 3600000` for computers. When disabled the human
readable values will be omitted. This makes sense for responses being consumed
only by machines.

pretty.description:
If set to `true` the returned JSON will be "pretty-formatted". Only use
this option for debugging only.
